datasets.name: Payments
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, id#, hdate, interestdebt, overduedebt,bankinterestdebt, trid, inttrid
  FROM cra_payments
  where id# = :ContractID
order by hdate

datasets.name: DepositInfo
datasets.sql:
select
     cust.name,
     cont.currency,
     cont.customerid,
     cs.ostat
from customers cust,
     tenostat cs,
     cra_contracts cont,
     cra_accounts cacc
where
cont.id = :ContractID and 
cust.id = cont.customerid and
cacc.id# = cont.id and
cs.acc_id=cacc.interestaccid

datasets.name: CustAcc
datasets.sql:
select id# as clientaccid ,
      cra_contract.Get_ContractAccount(interestaccid) as InterestAccNo
from cra_accounts
where id# =:contractid
